'''Mark David Williamson''' (born December 1957) is a British businessman. He serves as the chairman of [[Imperial Brands]].

Mark Williamson was born in December 1957{{where|date=September 2017}}.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://beta.companieshouse.gov.uk/company/03236483/officers |title=IMPERIAL BRANDS PLC - Officers (free information from Companies House) |website=Beta.companieshouse.gov.uk |date= |accessdate=14 April 2016}}</ref>

Williamson "qualified as Chartered Accountant in South Africa in 1983."<ref name="bloomberginternationalpower">{{cite web|title=International Power Plc (IPR:London): Mark D. Williamson CA (SA)|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=8096527&privcapId=22372343|website=Bloomberg|accessdate=28 September 2017}}</ref> He was the chief financial officer of [[Engie Energy International|International Power]] from 2003 to 2012.<ref name="bloomberginternationalpower"/> He is the chairman of [[Imperial Brands]], and a non-executive director of [[National Grid plc|National Grid]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www2.nationalgrid.com/About-us/Our-Board/Mark-Williamson/ |title=Mark Williamson |publisher=National Grid |date=3 September 2012 |accessdate=14 April 2016}}</ref>
